summary: Writes a checksummed byte sequence into a growable buffer. First flushes the target via UnicodeBufferFlusher(a1), then sets a mode/count field at this + 5799 to 8. When a4 is set it appends a 4-byte integrity trailer for a3 (low byte, high byte, one's-complement low, one's-complement high) to the buffer at base v5[2] plus cursor v5[5]. When a3 is nonzero it then copies a3 bytes from a2 into the same buffer, advancing the cursor per byte, and returns a3 (0 after a full copy).

local_names.a2: source bytes copied into the buffer
local_names.a3: length of the payload and the encoded value of the checksum trailer
local_names.a4: flag selecting whether the checksum trailer is written
local_names.v5: buffer object; v5[2] is the buffer base and v5[5] is the write cursor

operations.description: UnicodeBufferFlusher(a1) flushes the target stream/buffer before writing
Sets the field at this + 5799 to 8 (mode or pending-count marker)
When a4 is nonzero, appends a 4-byte checksum trailer for a3 (low, high, one's-complement low, one's-complement high) at base v5[2] + cursor v5[5] and advances the cursor
When a3 is nonzero, enters the payload copy loop over a2
Copies a3 bytes from a2 into the buffer at base v5[2] + cursor v5[5], advancing the cursor one per byte until result reaches 0
Returns a3, which is 0 after a full payload copy (or a3 unchanged when the copy guard is skipped)
Invoked by BitstreamWriteBits for checksummed payload writes

unresolved: The pointer v5 arrives uninitialized in the decompiled body (held in ecx) and is treated as this; its exact type and the meaning of the field at this + 5799 are not defined
The buffer base/length fields (v5[2] and v5[5]) are untyped; no capacity or bounds check is visible in this packet
